decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 4 - A shop window display shall be provided at all times, to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority in a manner compatible with a shopping street.

Condition : 5 - The food preparation, demonstration and storage use hereby permitted shall be ancillary to the approved A2 (Wedding/Catering Booking Office) use hereby permitted and the premises shall not be used as a restaurant, caf?, hot food takeaway or public house, nor principally for the preparation of food for consumption off the premises.

Condition : 6 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided in accordance with the approved plans received 4 December 2008 and nu7mbered LB/01 and LB/02, before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:(a)	A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the site.(b)	The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one meter above eaves level or one meter above openable windows of nearby properties.(c)	The ducting shall be circular.(d)	The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.(e)	The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.(f)	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.(g)	The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.

Condition : 7 - The use shall not commence until a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house one 1100 litre galvanized steel Eurobin has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling. The storage area and bin shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area. The lid of the Eurobin shall be fixed and shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into it. Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from the site no less frequently than once a week.

Condition : 8 - Before the use hereby permitted is brought into operation, details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the premises and the residential flats above shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented before the use commences and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of existing A1 (hair salon) use to wedding/catering service booking office with an ancillary area for demonstration purposes and storage
